description:
The Family Pension scheme under the Government of India is a significant welfare initiative that provides financial assistance to the families of deceased government employees. 

This scheme is specifically designed to support the dependents of employees who have served in various government departments and have passed away while in service or after retirement. 

The Family Pension scheme aims to ensure that the families of government employees do not face financial hardships due to the sudden loss of their primary breadwinner. 

The scheme was formally launched in 1971 as part of the broader pension reforms initiated by the Government of India. 

The primary objective of the Family Pension scheme is to provide a monthly pension to the eligible family members of the deceased employee. 

This pension is intended to replace a portion of the income lost due to the death of the employee. 

The Family Pension scheme is governed by the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 1972. 

Under this scheme, the family pension is typically granted to the spouse of the deceased employee. 

In the absence of a spouse, the pension can be extended to children or dependent parents. 

The amount of family pension is calculated as a percentage of the last drawn pay of the deceased employee. 

As of the latest updates, the family pension is set at 30% of the last pay drawn by the employee. 

There is a minimum family pension amount that is guaranteed, which is currently set at ₹9,000 per month. 

The maximum family pension amount is capped at ₹1,25,000 per month. 

The family pension is subject to periodic revisions based on the recommendations of the 7th Pay Commission. 

The eligibility criteria for the Family Pension scheme are clearly defined. 

The applicant must be a legal heir of the deceased employee. 

The spouse is the primary beneficiary and is eligible for the family pension. 

If the spouse is not available, the children of the deceased employee can claim the pension. 

In the absence of both spouse and children, dependent parents can receive the family pension. 

The age limit for children to be eligible for the family pension is typically 25 years. 

However, if the child is disabled, there is no age limit for eligibility. 

The income criteria for the family pension are not strictly defined, but the family must be dependent on the deceased employee. 

The application process for the Family Pension scheme involves several specific steps. 

The first step is to obtain the death certificate of the deceased employee. 

The applicant must also provide proof of their relationship with the deceased employee. 

Documents required include the service record of the deceased employee and a bank account statement. 

The application form for the family pension can be obtained from the respective department or downloaded from the official government website. 

Once the application is filled out, it must be submitted to the head of the department where the deceased employee was last employed. 

The head of the department will verify the application and forward it to the concerned pension sanctioning authority. 

The pension sanctioning authority will process the application and issue the family pension order. 

The family pension is disbursed on a monthly basis. 

Typically, the pension is credited to the bank account of the beneficiary by the first week of every month. 

In case of any delay, beneficiaries can contact the concerned department for assistance. 

The implementing authority for the Family Pension scheme is the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances, and Pensions. 

The Department of Pension and Pensioners’ Welfare oversees the execution of this scheme. 

The official website for further information is https://www.pensionersportal.gov.in. 

Beneficiaries can also reach out to the nearest government office for assistance with their applications. 

The Family Pension scheme is a crucial safety net for families of government employees. 

It ensures that they have a steady source of income after the loss of their loved ones. 

The scheme has been instrumental in providing financial security to thousands of families across India. 

As of the latest statistics, approximately 60 lakh family pensioners are benefiting from this scheme. 

The government has made efforts to streamline the application process to ensure timely disbursement of pensions. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform potential beneficiaries about their rights and the application process. 

The Family Pension scheme is part of a larger framework of social security measures in India. 

It reflects the government's commitment to the welfare of its employees and their families. 

The scheme is regularly reviewed and updated to meet the changing needs of beneficiaries. 

In conclusion, the Family Pension scheme under the Government of India serves as a vital support system for the families of deceased government employees. 

It provides them with financial stability and peace of mind during difficult times. 

The scheme continues to evolve, ensuring that it meets the needs of its beneficiaries effectively. 

For more information regarding the Family Pension scheme, beneficiaries are encouraged to visit the official government website or contact the relevant authorities.
